profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary: Experienced Information Technology Engineer with a demonstrated history of working on Web Applications. Skilled in Public Speaking, JavaScript, Rapid Prototyping, and DevSecOps. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from Bloomsburg University of Pennsylvania.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Leads team efforts in adopting AI technologies, ensuring compliance with industry standards and capitalizing on emerging trends to optimize development workflows and enhance product capabilities.
- Overses major updates and migrations for the external framework, including CDN path optimization and npm package management, resulting in improved system stability and increased developer productivity.
- Directs initiatives to elevate user experience and web accessibility, including optimizing interface behaviors, resolving content overflow issues, and standardizing typography to ensure readability and inclusivity on the HelpZone platform.
- Develops and implements comprehensive data tagging and metrics frameworks, enabling accurate tracking of user interactions and empowering data-driven product enhancements.
- Proactively leads exploratory projects in UI prototyping and AI application, aligning technical solutions with strategic product goals and brand guidelines to drive continuous innovation.
- Strengthens partnerships across product, UX, and engineering teams to align priorities and deliver seamless outcomes. Mentors team members, successfully onboarded new hires, and empowered others to take ownership—resulting in increased accountability and positive feedback from cross-functional partners.
- Demonstrates a strong influence and composure by engaging stakeholders with purposeful communication and active listening. Enables team resilience and ownership, guides the team through challenges with a solution-driven mindset, and implements practices that drive durable growth and lasting value.

positions.title: Security Prime
positions.description:
- Accountable for the Business of Security for 16 service offerings (about 200 applications) 
- Responsible for selection and training of Partner Security Advocates 
- Educating leadership on new security policies, standards and guidelines 
- Communicating clearly when vulnerabilities/incidents 
- Providing awareness of security controls that improve the security posture of applications

positions.title: IT Engineer
positions.description:
- Design and develop scalable technical solutions based on business requirements and industry best practices
- Aid in maintaining operational excellence in the Cisco.com Portfolio by influencing developers to leverage quality scans, code review, and unit tests 
- Create scalable UI components that aligns to marketing’s unified brand imaging and creating a connected customer experience across Cisco.com and other digital properties 
- Use web component technology to create reusable UI elements across Cisco’s many platforms driving web development best practices, brand alignment, and cost avoidance through reduced development time

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an iOS application to access Hershey's instantly consumable data
- Integrated application with Wit.ai API for speech to text
- Utilized Hershey's Single SignOn CocoaPod for access control
- Wrote business logic to interpret text results from Wit.ai into searches against internal systems and return results across local intranet
- Created dynamic front end to display results and use Core Data to cache results based on the frequency the call has been made
- Used Storyboards for user navigation through the app
- Distributed application to the enterprise using Fabric.io and Crashlytics
- Expanded application to use Xcode 7 beta and Watchos 2 beta to send top searches from an iPhone to an Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity 
- Technologies: Objective-C, Xcode, Git, Fabric.io, Wit.ai, Core Data, WatchConnectivity, WatchKit, CocoaPods

honors.title: IT@RTP's Employee of the Month April 2017
honors.description: "Your various contributions in making Cisco RTP better are admirable.  As an active member of the Connected Woman’s organization in RTP, you are improving the workplace for everyone by promoting diversity and inclusion.   It is obvious technology is your passion and you readily give back to budding technologists through various STEM activities including mentoring, judging events, and teaching.  If that is not enough, you care enough about the safety of Cisco employees to volunteer as a member of the Emergency Response Team. " - IT Site Council

honors.title: Student Representative on the COST Dean Search Committee
honors.description: Contributing member of the selection board for the Dean of the College of Science and Technology. Evaluated and interviewed candidates. Wrote and submitted candidate assessments against common criteria.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I aid in fire and medical emergencies, a volunteer position on top of my day job. As a lead team member I provide mentorship to new team members and take leadership roles during an incident. 

Training: First Aid, CPR, AED, Advanced Medical Training

This event had about 100 4th - 5th grade Girl Scouts interested in STEM fields. My group, which consisted of two other Computer Science girls, used Scratch tutorials (provided by Code.org) to introduce basic programming topics.

projects.title: CHILL Industry 4.0
projects.description:
Cisco Hyperinnovation Living Labs is an innovation practice designed as a corporate capability aimed at driving disruptive innovation with customers. As we enter into this hyperinnovation era, large corporates can no longer innovate as islands.This era calls for multi-party, multi-disciplinary solutions.

As a Build Team Member, I participated in CHILL by rapid prototyping possible solutions. https://vimeo.com/357989281

projects.title: CHILL Securing the Digitized Supply Chain Lab
projects.description:
Cisco Hyperinnovation Living Labs is an innovation practice designed as a corporate capability aimed at driving disruptive innovation with customers. As we enter into this hyperinnovation era, large corporates can no longer innovate as islands.This era calls for multi-party, multi-disciplinary solutions.
